title: A job is killed at 10 minutes and reports as cancelled
query: A CI job with timeout-minutes: 10 reports 'cancelled' every run, and the workflow has cancel-in-progress: true. Establish which of the two is killing it.
oracle: There is a plausible wrong explanation sitting next to the right one, and telling them apart needs the job's step table rather than its conclusion field. That is a diagnostic with two candidate causes and one discriminating observation. R2. Inline: one job, one log, and the wrong answer is available in the same place as the right one, which is a reason to look harder rather than to bring in help.
